_meta.description: Default theme + canvas presets for pdf-designer collage layouts. Shares the brand palette with themes/default-resume.json; adds canvas presets and collage-specific tokens.
_meta.palette_source: themes/default-resume.json#brand — one brand palette backs both document types.

_background_meta.description: Named page backgrounds for collage canvases — a flat color or a CSS gradient instead of the mode's flat bg. Selected with `--bg <id>` or `background` in collage-source.json. Any raw CSS color/gradient string is also accepted verbatim.
_background_meta.palette_source: Discord client chrome as captured in storage/collages/Screenshot 2026-07-19 2*.png — chat #313338, sidebar #2b2d31, embed card #1e1f22, app shell #111214; accents: Martian orange #f0561d (embed bar), link blue #00a8fc.

discord-slate.use: Default Discord grey — matches the client chrome the screenshots came from

discord-deep.use: Darker vertical fade, keeps bright screenshots dominant

discord-ember.use: Discord grey warming into the Martian orange accent

discord-signal.use: Discord grey cooling into the embed link blue

discord-radial.use: Center-top glow, good for hero-mosaic and spotlight layouts

flat-dark.use: Original flat dark — the pre-gradient default

_frame_meta.description: `frame` is the polaroid border color for the frame-scatter layout, per background. Replaces the hardcoded white, which fought every dark palette. Defaults to the mode's cell_border when a background declares no frame.
